sources.title: Today we're releasing our first security model: Wolf Defender
sources.snippet: This first model uses a ModernBERT-style architecture to validate the approach. For truly efficient on-device AI security inference, we already have several additional approaches in development. We're excited to share Wolf Defender with the community and contribute to making AI systems safer.
